features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: You gain proficiency in one skill (Performance, History, Insight, Persuasion, or Animal Handling) or one language of your choice.

features.name: Unwavering Mark
features.desc: When you hit with a melee attack, you mark the target: while it is near you, it has Disadvantage on attacks against others, and you can make a special attack against it as a Bonus Action with Advantage and extra damage (a number of times equal to your Strength modifier).

features.name: Born to the Saddle
features.desc: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid falling off your mount; if you fall 10 feet or less, you land on your feet; mounting and dismounting costs only 5 feet of movement.

features.name: Warding Maneuver
features.desc: As a Reaction, you add 1d8 to the AC of yourself or a creature within 5 feet against an attack; if the attack hits, the target has Resistance to its damage (a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier).

features.name: Hold the Line
features.desc: You make an Opportunity Attack against an enemy that moves 5 feet or more while within your reach; on a hit, its Speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn.

features.name: Ferocious Charger
features.desc: If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line before an attack, on a hit you force the target to make a Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition (once per turn).

features.name: Vigilant Defender
features.desc: You gain a special Reaction for Opportunity Attacks, usable once on each creature's turn other than yours; it can't be combined with your normal Reaction on the same turn.
